A [[Species/Legends|species]] of large, [[Color/Legends|yellow]] '''quadrupeds''' was used as a mount and beast of burden on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orvax IV]]. They had four-toed feet, and towered over many of the other [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] species who were on the planet.<ref name="DT 3" />
